Name: Custom Tool Tile
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[u][b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b][/u]

This mod lets you change the appearance of the red square outline that indicates which tile the current tool will target when you hold down the shift key.

You can optionally set the color to phase either prismatic or between two colors in the config.

You can toggle a shadow under the square to give it definition.

You can have the current tool icon show inside the square.

You can edit the file assets/square.png or target "aedenthorn.CustomToolTile/square" using Content Patcher to change the shape of the outline.


[u][b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b][/u]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game. To change colors, you will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url] as well.

Translations should use config variable names as the keys, adding .Desc to the end of the key for hover descriptions.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
